comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 3a9441f and manuals/README.md. The output is simply the input multiplied by the interval in semitones divided by the number of steps and by the fine-tune factor, so twelve steps of an octave passes pitch through unchanged. Fine tune runs 0.97 to 1.03 and is shown as a percentage with 100 subtracted. The interval switch has fourteen positions and a new module starts on position 9, two octaves, with 33 steps. The display is drawn by the module and carries no controls.
